title: Settings
nextRecording: Changes will apply to the next recording.

general.uiLanguageHint: Menus, buttons and text in the app, and the language the cover is written in. It doesn't change the meeting language (that's under Transcription).
general.autostartHint: The app will open on its own when you start your computer.
general.updatesHint: Looks for new versions of the app and the models, and installs them all at once.
general.checkOnOpenHint: This is the only connection Murmur makes on its own: GitHub sees your IP address and which version you have. Nothing else is sent.
general.detectMeetingsHint: When another app (Zoom, Meet, Teams…) starts using the microphone, Murmur offers to record.
general.calendarAlerts: Alert When a Calendar Meeting Starts
general.calendarAlertsHint: About 2 minutes before, with a button to start recording. The recording takes the event's title and guests.
general.calendarNeeded: You need to connect your calendar.
general.indicatorHint: A pill on the right of the screen to go back to Murmur, take a screenshot or stop recording. You can drag it.
general.compact: Compact Mode When Clicking the Indicator
general.compactHint: Murmur becomes narrow, next to the call and always on top, with just the notes.
general.showWhatsNewHint: A summary of what each new version brings, the first time you open Murmur.

calendar.footnote: Murmur reads the calendars in the macOS Calendar app. To add Google Calendar, add the account in System Settings › Internet Accounts.
calendar.denied: Denied. Turn on Murmur in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Calendars.
calendar.disconnected: Disconnected: Murmur doesn't read it. macOS still gives it permission; you can remove it in System Settings.
calendar.notConnected: To let you know when a meeting starts and give it the event's title. Read only.
calendar.connected: Connected. Murmur only reads it: it doesn't create or change anything.
calendar.noGuestsHint: By default, only events with guests or a video call link count as meetings.
calendar.emptyHint: Add one in the macOS Calendar app.

appearance.themeHint: Each theme has a light and a dark version. The preview shows both.
appearance.appearanceHint: Follow the system or always use light or dark mode.
appearance.primaryPanelHint: The other one shows alongside and can be hidden from the toolbar.

audio.micHint: Your voice and the room's. In a call, it shows up as “You”.
audio.deviceMissing: Not connected: the system one will be used.
audio.inputLevelInUse: The microphone is being used for recording right now.
audio.inputLevelHint: Speak to check that the microphone works.
audio.systemHint: Zoom, Meet, Teams… It's transcribed separately from the microphone and echo is removed, even with speakers. Audio only: Murmur doesn't see your screen.
audio.saveAudioHint: Compressed as Opus, one channel per source (about 11 MB per hour).

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.micDenied: Denied. Turn on Murmur in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Microphone.
permissions.micUndetermined: You haven't allowed it yet. macOS will ask you.
permissions.systemAudioDenied: Denied. Turn on Murmur in System Settings › Screen & System Audio Recording › System Audio Recording Only.
permissions.systemAudioUndetermined: To hear the other side of calls. macOS will ask you.
permissions.systemAudioGranted: To hear the other side of calls. Audio only: Murmur doesn't see your screen.
permissions.screenHint: Only for the screenshots you take from the indicator. Murmur never records your screen.

languages.caHint: When it's over, Whisper listens to the meeting again and rewrites the text with punctuation and capitals (about 6 minutes per hour of meeting). If Spanish is spoken, choose “Catalan + Spanish”: Whisper would turn it into Catalan.
languages.esHint: When it's over, Whisper listens to the meeting again and rewrites the text with punctuation and capitals (about 6 minutes per hour of meeting).
languages.caEsHint: Understands both languages, even mixed in the same sentence. Whisper doesn't run, since it only works in one language.
languages.enHint: Parakeet, by NVIDIA, transcribes live. When it's over, Whisper listens to the meeting again and rewrites the text (about 6 minutes per hour of meeting).

transcription.roomSpeakers: There Are Other People in the Room with Me
transcription.roomSpeakersHint: In a call, everything coming through the microphone is “You”. Turn this on if more than one person is in front of the same computer.
transcription.thresholdHint: Higher separates voices more; lower groups them.
transcription.verifySpeakersHint: Analyzes the whole meeting again to separate voices better. It can take a few minutes (about 7 per hour of meeting), but you can keep working meanwhile.
transcription.punctuateHint: Adds periods, commas and capitals to meetings in Catalan and Spanish (with Whisper or in English they're already there). Takes a few seconds.

intelligence.summarize: Generate the Cover When Recording Ends
intelligence.summarizeHint: A language model reads the transcript and writes the title, summary, decisions, tasks and sections. You can keep working meanwhile.
intelligence.privacy: Everything happens on this computer: the transcript never leaves it. Models are only downloaded if you turn the feature on, and you can delete them whenever you want.
intelligence.coverLanguageHint: In the meeting's language, “Catalan + Spanish” is written in Catalan. Meetings recorded before this version use the interface language.
intelligence.engineLocalHint: Gemma, on the computer. The transcript stays here, but it takes about 2–3 minutes for a 20-minute meeting.
intelligence.engineCloudHint: Faster and better, but the transcript is sent to {{provider}}. You need your own API key, billed separately by usage.
intelligence.privacyCloud: Each time a cover is generated, the transcript's text and the notes are sent to {{provider}}. The audio never leaves this computer, and the key is saved in the macOS keychain.

model.deleteMessage: {{name}} ({{size}}) will be deleted. You can download it again whenever you want.
model.notDownloadable: Can't be downloaded from the app yet · {{size}}

prompts.title: Cover Prompts
prompts.footnote: Answers always follow the same format (JSON), so you can change the text without breaking the cover. Changes apply to the next covers.
prompts.needMeeting: Open a finished meeting to try the prompt on it.
prompts.resultTime: Answer in {{seconds}} s · {{tokens}} tokens · {{total}} s total including reading

cloud.keyHint: A Claude or ChatGPT subscription won't do: you need an API key, billed separately by usage.
cloud.keySaved: Key saved in the keychain, ending in …{{hint}}
cloud.disconnectMessage: The {{company}} key will be removed from the keychain. Your existing covers don't change.
cloud.modelHint: Larger ones write better and cost more per cover.
